metadata.domain: Large Language Model / Foundation Model / AI Platform

evidence.trl_pathway: T03 (TRL 7) completes in 2 years which is plausible, and T01/T05 (TRL 6) each get 2 years which is tight but feasible; however T02 (TRL 5) is scheduled for a 0-quarter development window (2030-Q1 → 2030-Q1), making its TRL progression to completion effectively instantaneous and unrealistic.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy calls for exploratory, lower-TRL, R&D-heavy selections with patent-trend alignment, but the portfolio skews toward relatively mature technologies (TRL 6-7) with only one lower-TRL exploratory entry (T02 at TRL 5); the portfolio resembles incremental capability building more than genuine technology leadership.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no discernible evidence in the roadmap of competitor positioning, differentiation rationale, or timing designed to preempt rivals; technology selections appear driven by internal dependency logic rather than competitive landscape intelligence.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도, technologies should complete 1-2 years before market boom for preemption; T03 completes 1 year early (acceptable), but T01 and T05 complete 2.75 years after their boom windows, and T02 completes 1.5 years late — the majority of the portfolio misses the preemption window and arrives post-boom.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: Technologies selected (distributed training, LLM collaboration, inference acceleration, 3D generation) are plausibly in active patent-filing and growing market zones for the LLM domain, but the roadmap provides no explicit evidence of convergence-zone targeting; alignment appears incidental rather than deliberately engineered.

strengths: Dependency chain is logically structured with T03 as a foundational prerequisite enabling T01 and T05, reflecting sound systems thinking
Budget is fully utilized without violation, indicating disciplined resource allocation
weaknesses: T01 and T05 complete 2.75 years after their respective market boom windows, severely undermining market capture potential and contradicting both technology leadership and commercial value
T02 (3D spatial generation) has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), making it effectively a placeholder with no credible development plan
missing_technologies: Multi-agent orchestration / autonomous agent coordination framework (core to the multi-agent scenario and technology leadership)
Foundation model alignment and safety infrastructure (critical for leadership positioning in regulated markets)
Low-TRL emerging architecture research (e.g., neuromorphic or sparse mixture-of-experts) to substantiate 기술선도 posture
investment_issues: All three core technologies (T01, T02, T05) are classified Strategic/High yet all miss their market windows, meaning high investment is allocated to post-peak opportunities with diminishing returns
T02 receives High-tier investment despite TRL 5, zero development time, and a 1.5-year late arrival — risk-adjusted return is extremely poor
No Exploratory-tier investments exist in the portfolio, which is inconsistent with a 기술선도 strategy that should reserve budget for early-stage, high-uncertainty bets
timing_issues: LLM 기반 컨텍스트 인식 협업 completes in 2030-Q1 but market boom is 2027-Q2 — a 2.75-year post-boom arrival renders the investment strategically ineffective
대규모 모델 추론 가속화 has identical 2.75-year post-boom timing error, suggesting a systemic scheduling problem in the middle tier of the roadmap
생성형 AI 기반 3D 공간 생성 arrives 1.5 years after its boom window and has a zero-duration development schedule, making execution infeasible
